# Verifiable.NET — Compact LLM & Engineer Reference (`llms.txt`)

Compile-time formal verification and boundary marshaling for standard C# (.NET 9 / .NET 10) via Roslyn Source Generators, Analyzers, CodeFixes, and Z3 SMT solving—zero runtime/Wasm payload overhead.

## 1. Environment Variables (Always Set in Agent Runs)

- `VERIFIABLE_AGENT=1` — appends single-line `<verifiable-counterexample>{...}</verifiable-counterexample>` JSON on `VER102` (includes `"reason"` when spirit text is present).
- `GALAXYCHECK_AGENT=1` — deterministic GalaxyCheck seed `0`, suppresses passing output, caps failure output to 40 lines, emits `<galaxycheck-failure>{...}</galaxycheck-failure>`.
- `GALAXYCHECK_SEED=n` — explicit property seed override.
- `VERIFIABLE_Z3_PATH` — optional explicit path to `z3` / `z3.exe` (also auto-discovered from `.tools/z3/`, `~/.verifiable/z3/`, and `PATH`).

Run all checks:
- Windows: `.\scripts\verify.ps1` (install Z3: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install-z3.ps1`)
- Linux/macOS: `./scripts/verify.sh` (install Z3: `bash scripts/install-z3.sh`)

## 2. Type-Safe Contract Surface (`Verifiable.Contracts`)

No string DSLs. All contracts are typed C# code compiled normally; `Spec.*` methods carry `[Conditional("VERIFIABLE_SPEC")]` and are erased from IL.
Every contract accepts an optional plain-English **spirit** string (`because` / `description`) that explains *why* the rule exists in compiler errors, runtime `ContractViolation.Message`, and `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`/`JsonException`.

### Verification Scopes (Hierarchical Cascade)
Target targets: `Assembly | Class | Struct | Method` (nearest wins; overrides parent).
- `[Verifiable]` — enforce `VER001`–`VER006` as Build Errors + run Z3 SMT proofs.
- `[VerifiableCandidate]` — migration mode: enforce `VER001`–`VER006` as Warnings.
- `[Unverifiable]` — opt a boundary type or method out of an enclosing `[assembly: Verifiable]` or class `[Verifiable]`.
- `[CheckedArithmetic]` — prove 32/64-bit arithmetic cannot overflow inside verified methods.
- `[PureAxiom]` — marks a trusted pure helper/intrinsic callable from verified scopes.

### Constrained Type Aliases (`[TypeAlias<T>]` / `[Refined<T>]`)
Push value invariants into nominal zero-allocation `readonly partial record struct` types:
```csharp
[TypeAlias<int>("IDs start at 1 so zero never aliases an uninitialized slot.")]
public readonly partial record struct TodoId
{
    public static bool IsValid(int value) => value >= 1;
}
```
Generated (`Verifiable.Generators`):
- Constructor `(T Value)`, `IComparable<Self>`, implicit widening operator `implicit operator T(Self)`, numeric `<, <=, >, >=`, `.Length`/`.ToString()` for `string`.
- `[PureAxiom] From(T value)` (`Spec.Requires(IsValid(value), description)` + `Spec.Ensures<Self>(r => r.Value == value)` + `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` with `description`).
- `TryFrom(T, out Self)` and `TryFrom(T) -> MarshalResult<Self>` / `TryMarshal(T, fieldName)`.
- `<Self>JsonConverter` validating JSON values & dictionary keys (throws `JsonException` with `description`).
- For `0 <= value < N` predicates on `int`: `UpperBoundExclusive` and `[PureAxiom] ReadUnchecked<T>(ReadOnlySpan<T>)`.

### Type Invariants (`[Invariant]`)
Attach `[Invariant("why")]` to any parameterless `bool` instance method or property on an immutable record/struct:
```csharp
[Invariant("Across the ledger, total debits must equal total credits.")]
public bool IsBalanced() => TotalDebits == TotalCredits;
```
Proved on return values by Z3 and enforced at runtime inside `[InboundPort]` gates.

### Method & Loop Contracts (`Spec.*`)
- `Spec.Requires(bool condition, string? because = null)`
- `Spec.RequiresWhen(bool condition, bool requirement, string? because = null)`
- Placement: `Spec.Requires` / `Spec.RequiresWhen` must be in the leading contract block, the top-level statements before the first non-`Spec.*` statement (`Requires` and `Ensures` in any order; also constructors, accessors and `=> Spec.Requires(...)`). Elsewhere (inside `if`/`else`/loops/blocks/lambdas/local functions, or after another statement) it is `VER101` and is not assumed or required of callers. Use `Spec.RequiresWhen(condition, requirement, because)` at the top instead.
- `Spec.Ensures<TResult>(Func<TResult, bool> predicate, string? because = null)`
- `Spec.Ensures(bool condition, string? because = null)` (use `Spec.Result<TResult>()` if needed)
- `Spec.EnsuresWhen<TResult>(bool condition, Func<TResult, bool> predicate, string? because = null)` / `Spec.EnsuresWhen(bool condition, bool postcondition, string? because = null)`
- `Spec.Implies(bool antecedent, bool consequent)` (`(=> antecedent consequent)` in Z3)
- `Spec.ForAll(int startInclusive, int endExclusive, Func<int, bool> predicate)` / `Spec.Exists(int startInclusive, int endExclusive, Func<int, bool> predicate)` (bounded Z3 `forall` / `exists` over integer indices)
- `Spec.LoopInvariant(bool condition, string? because = null)` (inside `while` loop)
- `Spec.Decreases(int|long measure, string? because = null)` (inside `while` loop; proves termination)

### Linear Obligation Tokens (`[MustConsume]`)
- `[MustConsume]` on a `readonly record struct` token returned by commands/factories.
- `[ConsumesObligation]` on terminal sink methods (e.g., HTTP send / SQLite commit).
- `Obligation.Discard(token, "reason")` to explicitly dismiss a linear token safely.

### Inbound Boundary Gates (`[InboundPort]`)
Put `[InboundPort]` on pure domain entry methods. Emits `Raw<Domain>` DTOs, `<Domain>Gate.TryMarshal(...)`, and `<Class>Port.<Method>(...)` returning `MarshalResult<TReturn>` with `ContractViolation` entries carrying spirit messages.

### Verified 1:1 DTO Projections (`[MapTo]`)
Generate verified 1:1 field/property projections without duplicating field-by-field `Spec.Ensures`:
- Type-level: `[MapTo(typeof(OrderState))]` (optional `MethodName = "..."`, repeatable) on a class/record/struct generates `[Verifiable] static partial class <Source>Mappings` with `To<Target>(this <Source> source)`.
- Method-level: `[MapTo]` (or `[MapTo(typeof(Target))]`) on a `static partial` method inside a `partial` class/struct generates the projection body (works even for external DTO types).
- Invalid or incomplete mappings emit `VER203` (use `[InboundPort]` when narrowing raw primitives into `[TypeAlias<T>]`).

### Domain Errors
Return `Result<T, TError>` (`Result<T, E>.Ok(v)` / `Result<T, E>.Fail(e)`) instead of throwing domain exceptions inside `[Verifiable]`.

## 3. Supported SMT Fragment (`VER101`–`VER106`)

- Types: `bool`, signed/unsigned ints (Int or BitVec under `[CheckedArithmetic]`), `decimal`/`float`/`double` (`Real`), `string`, `Guid`, enums (with unconditional underlying integral bounds; opt-in closed-domain axioms via `-p:VerifiableClosedEnums=true` or `[Verifiable]` on non-`[Flags]` enums), `DateOnly`, `DateTime`, `DateTimeOffset`, `TimeSpan`, `Nullable<T>`, immutable `readonly record struct` / `record`, write-once boundary DTO classes (field access/projections; reference `==`/`Equals` rejected), `Result<T, E>`, `ImmutableList<T>`, `ImmutableArray<T>` (distinct `IsDefault` state; use `[NonDefault]` on params/fields/returns or `-p:VerifiableNonDefaultImmutableArrays=true` / `.editorconfig` `verifiable.non_default_immutable_arrays = true` to assume initialized and reject `default` at call sites/returns), `IImmutableList<T>`, `IReadOnlyList<T>`, `ImmutableDictionary<K, V>`, `ImmutableHashSet<T>`, constrained `[TypeAlias<T>]` / `[Refined<T>]`.
- Expressions: local SSA, `if/else`, ternary `?:`, switch expressions, `with`, object initializers (`new State { ... }`), `while` loops with `LoopInvariant` + `Decreases`, pure `[Verifiable]`/`[PureAxiom]` modular calls (`Spec.Requires`/`Spec.RequiresWhen` + `Spec.Ensures`/`Spec.EnsuresWhen` instantiation), `Spec.Implies`, `Spec.ForAll`/`Spec.Exists`, sequence `Add`/`SetItem`/`RemoveAt`/`Insert`.
- Text & Regex: `string.IsNullOrEmpty`, `string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace`, `Trim()`, `Contains`/`StartsWith`/`EndsWith` (ordinal only), bounded `string.Join` (<= 32 elements), static `Regex.IsMatch` and `[GeneratedRegex]` factories via Z3 `str.in_re` (non-null obligations always enforced).
- Pure LINQ: `Any`, `All`, `Count`, `Where`, `Select`, and `GroupBy` uniqueness (`g => g.Count() > 1` / `== 1`) over immutable sequences (`ImmutableList<T>`, `ImmutableArray<T>`, `IImmutableList<T>`, `IReadOnlyList<T>`).
- Decimal & Calendar: `decimal.Round`/`Truncate`/`Floor`/`Ceiling` (constant decimals `0..28`, all `MidpointRounding` modes) and pure `DateOnly`/`DateTime`/`DateTimeOffset`/`TimeSpan` arithmetic with range/overflow checks (ambient `Now`/`UtcNow`/`Today` remain `VER004`).
- Source-visible (and cross-assembly exported via `[assembly: VerifiableContractMetadata]`) nonrecursive `[Verifiable]` helpers can specify their result with `=> expr` or a single `return expr;` after leading `Spec.Requires`/`Spec.RequiresWhen` / `Spec.Ensures`/`Spec.EnsuresWhen` statements, including both positional constructors and object initializers. Omitted arguments use their C# defaults at the call site; the callee is still verified for *all* argument values satisfying its preconditions.
- A `Spec.*` expression may call a supported helper (same-compilation or cross-assembly exported), including a `[Ghost]` method; the analyzer checks its preconditions on the path to the call. Ghost methods are for specification use, not executable calls from verified code. Inlining requires a supported expression and statically known target, not a generic method, recursive definition, or unexported private/metadata-only implementation. More complex executable helpers still need explicit contracts. The query CLI proves call preconditions and safety obligations (`Overflow`, `DivisionByZero`, `CollectionBounds`) separately before checking the claim; an unproved safety obligation makes the query inconclusive.

## 4. Elm-Style Diagnostics & Agent JSON Schema

All rules render with Elm formatting (`-- TITLE ---- File.cs`, numbered source line with `^` caret underline, `"Why this rule exists:"`, optional `Contract:` / `Counterexample:`, and `Fix:`):
- `VER001` (`MUTABLE STATE`): class, non-readonly struct, settable prop, mutable field, `ref`/`out`. Fix: `readonly record struct` / immutable `record` + `with`.
- `VER002` (`MUTABLE COLLECTION`): `List<T>`, `Dictionary<K,V>`, `HashSet<T>`, `T[]`. Fix: `ImmutableList<T>`, `ImmutableDictionary<K,V>`, `ImmutableHashSet<T>`, `ImmutableArray<T>`.
- `VER003` (`UNCHECKED INITIALIZATION`): `default(T)` / `new T()` on `[TypeAlias<T>]` or `[Invariant]` type. Fix: `T.From(...)`, `T.TryFrom(...)`, `[InboundPort]`.
- `VER004` (`AMBIENT AUTHORITY`): `DateTime.Now`/`UtcNow`, `Guid.NewGuid()`, `Random`, `Stopwatch`, `Environment.*`, mutable `static`. Pass values from the shell. Automatic clock/GUID hoisting is limited to eligible eager reads in private methods with same-document callers; preserve one read or allocation per item in loops and lambdas.
- `VER005` (`DISALLOWED CONTROL FLOW`): unannotated `while`/`foreach`, `throw`, `try/catch`, `async`/`await`, `lock`, `goto`. Fix: `LoopInvariant` + `Decreases` or `Result<T, TError>`.
- `VER006` (`UNVERIFIED CALL`): unverified callee, reflection, `dynamic`, unanalyzed delegate. Fix: `[Verifiable]` / `[PureAxiom]` / Sandwich I/O split.
- `VER007` (`UNCONSUMED OBLIGATION`): dropped, overwritten, discarded, or double-consumed `[MustConsume]` token. Fix: pass to `[ConsumesObligation]`, return, or `Obligation.Discard(...)`.
- `VER101` (`UNSUPPORTED CONTRACT`): invalid or non-lowerable contract. A warning (`METHOD NOT CHECKED`) when a `[Verifiable]` method with no contracts has code that cannot be lowered. A `Spec.Requires` / `Spec.RequiresWhen` outside the leading contract block is also `VER101` (fix: move it to the top or use `Spec.RequiresWhen`).
- `VER102` (`PROOF FAILED`): Z3 refutation (`SAT`) with counterexample, `Why this rule exists:`, and under `VERIFIABLE_AGENT=1`:
  `<verifiable-counterexample>{"rule":"VER102","symbol":"...","kind":"...","contract":"...","reason":"...","counterexample":{...},"smtHash":"...","fix":"Fix: ..."}</verifiable-counterexample>`
- `VER103` (`SOLVER COULD NOT DECIDE`): Z3 `unknown`/timeout.
- `VER104` (`Z3 SOLVER NOT FOUND`): missing Z3 binary, so nothing was proved. Error by default; `<VerifiableAllowMissingZ3>true</VerifiableAllowMissingZ3>` downgrades it to a warning.
- `VER105` (`CONTRADICTORY PREMISES`): a proof rests on assumptions that cannot hold. At the method: its assumptions contradict each other (lists the clashing `Spec.Requires` / `[Invariant]` / `[TypeAlias<T>]` rules). At a call: the callee's `Spec.Ensures` / `[PureAxiom]` cannot hold there although the call is reachable, so later goals on that path would be vacuous. Dead code is not reported.
- `VER106` (`VACUITY CHECK UNDECIDED`, Warning): Z3 could not decide, within its fixed work budget, whether those assumptions can hold, so the method's proofs may be vacuous. Simplify its contracts or split it into helpers.
- `VER201` (`INVALID CONSTRAINED TYPE`) / `VER202` (`MISSING ISVALID PREDICATE`) / `VER203` (`INVALID MAPTO PROJECTION`): generator declaration errors.
- `VER301` (`COMPLEX CONTRACT`, default `Info`, configurable via `.editorconfig` / `VerifiableMaxSpecClauses`): `Spec.Requires`/`Spec.Ensures` exceeds max top-level `&&` clauses (default 3; includes CodeFix to split) or uses nested ternaries.
- `VER302` (`MISSING CONTRACT EXPLANATION`, default `Info`): missing or blank `because` argument on `[Verifiable]` `Spec.Requires`/`Spec.Ensures` calls.

## 5. Packages

- `Verifiable.Contracts` (`netstandard2.0`, `net9.0`, `net10.0`)
- `Verifiable.Generators` (Roslyn source generator)
- `Verifiable.Analyzers` (Gatekeeper, Linear Types, Z3 SMT prover)
- `Verifiable.CodeFixes` (Incremental refactorings for `[VerifiableCandidate]`)
- `Verifiable.Testing` (GalaxyCheck stateful & crash/replay harnesses)
- `Verifiable.Query` (`net10.0` pure .NET Core CLI tool `verifiable-query`)

## 6. Query CLI (`Verifiable.Query` / `verifiable-query`)

Ask typed C# questions about `[Verifiable]` code and get Z3 unsat-core explanations ("why") or counterexamples ("why not"):
- `dotnet run --project src/Verifiable.Query -c Release -- ask --project App.csproj --target Type.Method --assert "result.X == 0" [--assume "cond"] [--because "why"]`
- `dotnet run --project src/Verifiable.Query -c Release -- check-invariant --project App.csproj --type StateType --expr "s => s.TotalDebits == s.TotalCredits"`
- `dotnet run --project src/Verifiable.Query -c Release -- list --project App.csproj` (also supports `--file <a.cs>` and `--stdin`)
- Flags: `--format elm|json`, `--timeout <ms>`, `--z3 <path>`, `--all`, `--verbose`
- Exit codes: `0`=proved, `1`=refuted, `2`=inconclusive, `3`=error/unbound claim, `4`=Z3 missing
- Under `VERIFIABLE_AGENT=1`, emits single-line `<verifiable-query-result>{...}</verifiable-query-result>` with `reasons[]` (unsat-core rules + spirit strings + `file:line`), `vacuous`, and `counterexamples[]`.
